title: Discover the Devin organization id from the API key
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. DEVIN_ORG_ID is only needed because it is not discovered; list organizations with the key, pick the single one (ask if several) and store it. Tests zc_devin_org_* against a fake API.
